title: RaceTechAssistant
description_short: Simple fuel and setup strategy tools for sim racing
description_long: A premium, responsive engineering assistant for sim racers to calculate optimal fuel strategy and precise tyre cold pressure adjustments. Designed with a retro-futuristic engineering-style interface, harmonized dark-mode color scheme, and smooth interactive micro-animations.

title: Maratona
description_short: A calculator for training zones, paces, and distances for runners
description_long: Welcome to Maratona! This is your comprehensive running calculator designed to quickly help you plan your training and race strategies.

title: Active Recall Hub
description_short: The ultimate tool to test your knowledge and create custom quizzes with ease
description_long: The ultimate tool to test your knowledge and create custom quizzes with ease (This is a placeholder for the long description. You can edit this in projects.json to provide rich, detailed information about the project, its features, and the technologies used.)

title: TripleCrown
description_short: The all-in-one racing dashboard for schedules and news
description_long: The all-in-one racing dashboard for schedules and news.

title: Prompt-Library
description_short: Collection of reusable AI prompts, organized by use case
description_long: A collection of high-performance prompts for coding, note-taking and architectural tasks.

title: Expense Tracker
description_short: A local personal finance manager powered by your CSV files
description_long: A modular, browser-based personal finance manager that works directly with your local CSV files. This application puts you in control of your data—no cloud required, no sign-ups, just privacy-focused financial tracking.

title: Running Data Analysis
description_short: Data analysis of nearly a decade of personal running data
description_long: This repository contains a data science project analyzing nearly a decade of personal running data. The data has been collected across various devices and platforms (Garmin, Xiaomi, manual Excel entries) and represents a complete timeline of athletic evolution, from early beginnings to structured, polarized training.

title: MotorONE News
description_short: High school project about Motorsport news web application
description_long: MotorONE News is a web application designed to deliver motorsport news and event schedules cleanly and effectively. Unregistered visitors can view Formula 1 timetables and access news for Formula 1, MotoGP, and WEC (World Endurance Competition). Registered users can personalize their news feeds through a preferences form to receive updates on additional motorsport series, including WRC, SuperBike, and NASCAR.

title: Jasmin JVM Compiler
description_short: Java compiler translating custom language P into JVM bytecode
description_long: A complete compiler and formal language toolkit developed in Java for the Formal Languages and Compilers course. Features Deterministic Finite Automata (DFAs), a custom lexical analyzer with comment handling, an LL(1) recursive-descent parser for prefix expressions and control structures (if, for, assign), and a syntax-directed code generator emitting Jasmin assembly targeting executable JVM bytecode.

title: Nuclear Reactor Simulator
description_short: Concurrent C simulation modeling atomic fission and energy production
description_long: A concurrent atomic chain reaction simulator developed in C for the Operating Systems course. Features a multi-process architecture consisting of Master, Atom, Activator, Feeder, and probabilistic Inhibitor processes. Implements POSIX shared memory, semaphores, message queues, UNIX signals, and modular execve process management without busy waiting, complete with real-time energy statistics and safe IPC cleanup handlers.

title: Cibora Database
description_short: Relational database design and SQL implementation for food delivery
description_long: A comprehensive database engineering project for a food delivery ecosystem named Cibora, developed for the Database Systems course. Includes complete domain analysis, ER conceptual modeling, relational normalization, and complex SQL implementation featuring e-wallet transactions, Top Partner performance metrics, GPS-based rider dispatch constraints, user review systems, and automated monthly analytics rankings.

title: Algorithms & Data Structures
description_short: Generic data structures and algorithms library in C and Java
description_long: A dual-language algorithms and data structures laboratory developed in C and Java. Features generic sorting implementations (Merge Sort, Quick Sort) benchmarked over 20M records, a dynamic programming Edit Distance spell checker, a generic Heap-based Priority Queue, and a Sparse Graph library implementing Prim's Minimum Spanning Forest algorithm benchmarked on real Italian geographical datasets.

title: JavaFX Mail Client
description_short: Multi-threaded JavaFX client-server email desktop application
description_long: A desktop mail system developed in Java for the Programming III course. Built on an asynchronous client-server architecture, it features a reactive JavaFX GUI with real-time inbox notifications, auto-reconnection resilience, and email operations (compose, reply, reply-all, forward) communicating over custom TCP sockets with object serialization and file-based server persistence.

title: Radio@UniTo Prototype
description_short: HCI user research, accessibility audit, and Figma web prototype
description_long: A Human-Computer Interaction project focused on user-centered design for Radio@UniTo, a university radio platform. Includes Nielsen heuristic usability evaluation on commercial radio sites, automated accessibility audits (WCAG), User Personas and Journey Mapping, structured Information Architecture, and a comprehensive high-fidelity interactive Figma prototype.

title: Movie Analytics Platform
description_short: Full-stack cinema analytics platform with microservices and WebSockets
description_long: A distributed full-stack cinema analytics platform built for the Web Technologies course. Features an Express.js API gateway coordinating Express and Java Spring Boot microservices, dual persistence in MongoDB (reviews, ratings) and PostgreSQL (940k+ movies, 5.7M+ actors), real-time Socket.io topic chatrooms, an interactive Handlebars frontend, and Jupyter Notebooks for large-scale data analytics and geographical visualizations.

title: Cat & Ring
description_short: Object-oriented Java system for catering event and menu management
description_long: An enterprise software engineering project developed for the Software Architecture & Systems course. Applies Object-Oriented Analysis & Design (OOAD), GoF design patterns, UML class and sequence diagrams, and a Java domain implementation for Cat & Ring—a catering platform orchestrating event management, chef menu composition, multi-role shift scheduling, kitchen task delegation, and recipe lifecycle states.
